devices.label: High-flow oxygen
devices.source: Teaching estimate. The FiO₂ delivered by a reservoir mask at 15 L/min varies with fit and breathing pattern.

devices.label: Venturi mask
devices.source: Fixed-performance device: FiO₂ set by the Venturi valve.

devices.label: Nasal cannula
devices.source: Teaching estimate. Variable-performance device; FiO₂ depends on flow and breathing pattern.

devices.label: Head tilt, chin lift
devices.onText: Airway opened with head tilt and chin lift.
devices.source: Teaching estimate of the benefit of opening an obstructed airway.

devices.label: Bag-valve-mask ventilation
devices.onText: Bag-valve-mask ventilation started, about 12 breaths a minute.
devices.source: Teaching estimate. Delivered FiO₂ and ventilation depend on mask seal and technique.

devices.label: Lie flat, raise legs
devices.source: Resuscitation Council UK (2021) anaphylaxis: lie flat, with or without legs raised, if hypotensive; sit up if breathing is difficult. Size of the BP effect is a teaching parameter.

procedures.label: Arterial line
procedures.doneText: Radial arterial line placed. Continuous blood pressure on the monitor.

procedures.label: Needle decompression
procedures.doneText: Needle decompression: a hiss of air.
procedures.source: ATLS 10th edition (2018): in adults, needle decompression at the 4th/5th intercostal space just anterior to the mid-axillary line.

procedures.label: Chest drain
procedures.doneText: Chest drain inserted. Swinging and bubbling.
procedures.source: ATLS 10th edition (2018): tube thoracostomy is definitive management after decompression.

procedures.label: Pelvic binder
procedures.doneText: Pelvic binder applied at the level of the greater trochanters.

procedures.label: Major haemorrhage protocol
procedures.sub: Blood bank, products in balanced ratio
procedures.doneText: Major haemorrhage protocol activated. O-negative blood is in the fridge; packs follow.

procedures.label: Refer for haemorrhage control
procedures.doneText: Trauma surgeon and interventional radiology on their way for definitive haemorrhage control.

procedures.label: Activate primary PCI
procedures.doneText: Cath lab activated. The team will take him in about 20 minutes.

procedures.label: Refer to critical care
procedures.doneText: Critical care outreach called. ICU registrar coming to review.

procedures.label: Refer for urgent dialysis
procedures.doneText: Renal team contacted. Emergency dialysis being arranged.

procedures.label: Urinary catheter
procedures.doneText: Urinary catheter inserted. Hourly urine output monitoring started.

procedures.label: Tracheal intubation
procedures.sub: Definitive airway by an experienced airway operator
procedures.doneText: Tracheal tube placed and confirmed with waveform capnography. Ventilating through the tube.
procedures.source: Early definitive airway control by an experienced operator in peri-arrest asthma or anaphylaxis: AMAX4 algorithm (B. McKenzie, amax4.com; summarised by S. Carley, St Emlyn’s, 13 June 2023). Added after the AMAX4 simulation video annotation.

procedures.label: Front-of-neck access
procedures.sub: Surgical airway when you can’t intubate or oxygenate
procedures.doneText: Scalpel–bougie–tube cricothyroidotomy done. Ventilating through the neck.
procedures.alreadyText: There is already a surgical airway.
procedures.source: Difficult Airway Society 2015 guidelines (Frerk C et al., Br J Anaesth 2015): scalpel cricothyroidotomy for can’t intubate, can’t oxygenate. Done at about 2:30 in the AMAX4 simulation video when bag-mask ventilation failed.
